name: Brass Clock Face
description: Close-up photograph of the stopped clock. Hands locked at 11:47. Faint scratch on the glass forming the digits 4 and 7.
analysis: The scratch is deliberate and was made from the outside. The mechanism shows no signs of recent movement.

name: Witness Statement A
description: Signed statement claiming a chime was heard at the exact moment the clock stopped.
analysis: The Chronology Wing has no functioning chime mechanism. The claim is physically inconsistent with the location.

name: Maintenance Log Fragment
description: Torn page from the 1987 service record. Mentions 'silent mode engaged permanently'.
analysis: Confirms the clock was intentionally silenced. Supports the theory of a modified alarm rather than a broken device.

name: Letter #1 — Future Date
description: Cream paper letter dated three years ahead. Underlined word: OBSERVE.
analysis: Paper stock matches 1962 discontinued archive stationery. Handwriting consistent across series.

name: Letter #2 — Pattern Seed
description: Second letter in the series. Underlined sequence continues the message.
analysis: When combined with Letter #1 the underlined words begin to form a readable phrase.

name: Cipher Card
description: Faded card with a simple letter substitution grid found behind a shelf.
analysis: Key for decoding the underlined sequence into coordinates and a date.

name: Visitor Book Anomaly
description: Unlogged entry matching the decoded date from the letters.
analysis: Confirms the letters point to a real, unrecorded visit.

name: Official Group Photograph
description: Public display photograph showing seven committee members.
analysis: The seventh figure appears slightly softer in focus than the others — possible composite.

name: Original Glass Negative
description: Cold-vault negative showing only six figures. Empty space where the seventh should stand.
analysis: No emulsion damage. The absence is original to the exposure.

name: Meeting Minutes 1974
description: Typed minutes listing six attendees. Margin note references missing memo 74-11-B.
analysis: Direct contradiction with the public plaque and photograph.

name: Reel-to-Reel Tape
description: Metal canister labeled 'Test Tone — Do Not Play'. Contains patterned static.
analysis: Static bursts form a consistent short-long pattern suitable for encoding.

name: Observatory Log Excerpt
description: Handwritten note confirming the pattern was intentional.
analysis: Links the tape to deliberate logging of anomalous signals.

name: Catalogue Gap Note
description: 1991 audit remark dismissing the missing entry as clerical error.
analysis: The dismissal itself is suspicious given the physical existence of the sealed box.

name: Sealed Box 4472
description: Unlisted storage box containing seven folders of correspondence and maps.
analysis: Contents describe a research annex that never appears in official histories.

name: Annex Photograph
description: Single photograph of a temporary structure not present on any current map.
analysis: Visual proof of the annex that was later erased from records.
